text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak opens new parliament session: Egypt has embarked on a new stage to change the face of life in the country. Mubarak said a giant project to irrigate the Western Desert was a necessity and it should look at special incentives for foreign investment in the scheme.

- Mubarak says Egypt has been transformed from a country suffering from a deficit of resources to the largest country ripe for investment in the Middle East. Mubarak says there is no time to waste and we must persist in our swift movement toward economic reform.
- 78 countries taking part in the Middle East and North Africa Economic Conference.
- Mubarak and Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi speak by telephone on Middle East developments and issues of mutual interest.
- Mubarak says "We have been victorious in our reform movement and are entering an era of large projects."
- Mubarak opens the economic conference tomorrow. Foreign investment welcomed.
